Title: Users can't access Excel workbooks from Power BI and receive an error message

User impact: Users can't access Excel workbooks from Power BI and receive an error message.

More info: Impact is specific to the September 2026 release of the Power BI desktop client and Power BI on the web.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Power BI and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users can't access Excel workbooks from Power BI and receive an error message

User impact: Users can't access Excel workbooks from Power BI and receive an error message.

More info: Impact is specific to the September 2026 release of the Power BI desktop client and Power BI on the web.

When users attempt to access Excel workbooks from Power BI, they receive an error that states, "The input couldn't be recognized as a valid Excel document."

Current status: We're reproducing the impact using our internal testing environment to gain clarity on the issue, so that we can determine our next steps to isolate the root cause.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and any user attempting to access Excel workbooks from the September 2026 release of the Power BI desktop client or Power BI on the web is impacted.

Next update by: Friday, September 18, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC
